description: This file defines the DirectWriteSubscriber class, which handles sandbox events related to direct-write mode in the Drupal package manager, including managing maintenance mode states during dependency updates.

classes.name: DirectWriteSubscriber
classes.description: Handles sandbox events for direct-write mode, managing maintenance mode and issuing warnings during dependency operations.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events and corresponding handler methods for the subscriber.

methods.name: warnAboutDirectWrite
methods.description: Logs a warning if direct-write mode is enabled.

methods.name: enterMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Sets the system into maintenance mode before a direct-mode require operation if no errors are present.

methods.name: exitMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Restores the previous maintenance mode state after a direct-mode require operation.
